description: This file provides utility functions for managing date parameters, including formatting dates into ISO strings and merging date-related parameters with other query parameters for API requests.

methods.name: toDateParamStrings({ startDate, endDate } = {})
methods.description: Converts start and end date inputs into ISO string format without milliseconds, handling invalid inputs gracefully.

methods.name: withDateParams(params = {}, dateRange = {})
methods.description: Merges existing query parameters with normalized date parameters, supporting legacy parameter names and ensuring correct date formatting for API calls.
